```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(glue)

# Set up working directory (use project-root paths)
if (!file.exists(here::here("R", "cache_config.R"))) {
  stop("Cannot find helper file. Check that here::here returns the project root")
}
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
# FReD-specific configuration (dataset-independent)
FRED_GSHEET_URL <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv"
SCORE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED <- params$include_score
SCORE_DATA_PATH <- here::here("cos_score_integration", "cos_test_set_phase1_prepared.xlsx")
FRED_OUTPUT <- here::here("output", "FReD.xlsx")

cat("\n=== FReD Preparation Pipeline ===\n")
cat("Dataset-specific configuration:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Google Sheets URL: %s\n", substr(FRED_GSHEET_URL, 1, 80)))
cat(sprintf("  SCORE Integration: %s\n", if (SCORE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED) "ENABLED" else "DISABLED"))
cat(sprintf("  Output: %s\n", FRED_OUTPUT))
```

## Step 1: Source Helper Functions

```{r source-helpers}
cat("\n### Step 1: Loading helper functions\n")

source(here::here("R", "cache_config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data_cleaning.R"))
source(here::here("R", "crossref_cache.R"))
source(here::here("R", "augmentation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "openalex_cache.R"))

cat("✓ Helper functions loaded\n")
cat("  - Data cleaning\n")
cat("  - CrossRef/DataCite caching\n")
cat("  - Data augmentation\n")
cat("  - OpenAlex metadata\n")
```

## Step 2: Download FReD Data

```{r download-data}
cat("\n### Step 2: Downloading FReD data from Google Sheets\n")

# Download from Google Sheets
message("Downloading from: ", substr(FRED_GSHEET_URL, 1, 100), "...")

fred_raw <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(FRED_GSHEET_URL, show_col_types = FALSE)
}, error = function(e) {
  stop("Failed to download FReD data. Check URL and network connection.\n",
       "Error: ", e$message)
})

cat(sprintf("✓ Downloaded %d rows × %d columns\n", nrow(fred_raw), ncol(fred_raw)))

# Filter for validated - chosen status
if ("status" %in% names(fred_raw)) {
  fred_filtered <- fred_raw %>% filter(status == "validated - chosen")
  cat(sprintf("✓ Filtered for 'validated - chosen' status: %d rows\n", nrow(fred_filtered)))
} else {
  fred_filtered <- fred_raw
  warning("No 'status' column found, using all data")
}

# Remove exclusions
if ("exclusion" %in% names(fred_filtered)) {
  fred_filtered <- fred_filtered %>% filter(is.na(exclusion))
  cat(sprintf("✓ Removed excluded entries: %d rows remaining\n", nrow(fred_filtered)))
}

fred_raw <- fred_filtered
```

## Step 3: SCORE Integration (Optional)

```{r score-integration}
cat("\n### Step 3: SCORE Integration\n")

if (SCORE_INTEGRATION_ENABLED) {
  cat("Status: ENABLED\n")

  if (file.exists(SCORE_DATA_PATH)) {
    score_data <- readxl::read_excel(SCORE_DATA_PATH)
    cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded SCORE data: %d rows\n", nrow(score_data)))

    # Ensure column compatibility
    common_cols <- intersect(names(fred_raw), names(score_data))
    fred_raw <- bind_rows(
      fred_raw %>% select(all_of(common_cols)),
      score_data %>% select(all_of(common_cols))
    )

    cat(sprintf("✓ Merged with FReD data\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  Total rows after SCORE merge: %d\n", nrow(fred_raw)))
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("SCORE Integration enabled but file not found: %s\n", SCORE_DATA_PATH))
  }
} else {
  cat("Status: DISABLED (use params: include_score: true to enable)\n")
}
```

## Step 4: Data Cleaning

```{r cleaning}
cat("\n### Step 4: Data Cleaning\n")

cleaning_result <- clean_fred_data(fred_raw)
fred_cleaned <- cleaning_result$cleaned_data
cleaning_report <- cleaning_result$report

# Display cleaning report
cat(cleaning_report)
cat("\n✓ Data cleaning complete\n")
cat(sprintf("  Rows: %d\n", nrow(fred_cleaned)))
```

## Step 4b: DOI Validation

```{r doi-validation}
cat("\n### Step 4b: DOI Validation\n")

# Check DOI format (should start with "10.")
fred_cleaned <- fred_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    doi_o_valid = is.na(doi_o) | str_starts(tolower(doi_o), "10."),
    doi_r_valid = is.na(doi_r) | str_starts(tolower(doi_r), "10.")
  )

invalid_indices_o <- !fred_cleaned$doi_o_valid
invalid_o <- sum(invalid_indices_o)

if (invalid_o > 0) {
  show_all <- invalid_o < 10
  n_to_show <- if (show_all) invalid_o else 5
  vals <- head(fred_cleaned$doi_o[invalid_indices_o], n_to_show)
  label <- if (show_all) "Invalid doi_o values:" else "Example invalid doi_o values:"
  cat(sprintf("⚠ Found %d invalid doi_o values\n", invalid_o),
      paste(label, paste(vals, collapse = ", ")), "\n")
}

invalid_indices_r <- !fred_cleaned$doi_r_valid
invalid_r <- sum(invalid_indices_r)

if (invalid_r > 0) {
  show_all <- invalid_r < 10
  n_to_show <- if (show_all) invalid_r else 5
  vals <- head(fred_cleaned$doi_r[invalid_indices_r], n_to_show)
  label <- if (show_all) "Invalid doi_r values:" else "Example invalid doi_r values:"
  cat(sprintf("⚠ Found %d invalid doi_r values\n", invalid_r),
      paste(label, paste(vals, collapse = ", ")), "\n")
}

# Remove validation columns (keep data for now)
fred_cleaned <- fred_cleaned %>% select(-doi_o_valid, -doi_r_valid)

if (invalid_o == 0 && invalid_r == 0) {
  cat("✓ All DOIs have valid format\n")
}
```

## Step 6: Generate IDs

```{r ids}
cat("\n### Step 6: Generating identifiers\n")

fred_with_ids <- fred_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    fred_id = str_remove(id, "_[a-z]{1,2}$"),
    effect_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  group_by(ref_o, study_o, ref_r, study_r) %>%
  mutate(entry_id = first(row_number())) %>%
  ungroup()

cat(sprintf("✓ Generated identifiers\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Unique fred_ids: %d\n", n_distinct(fred_with_ids$fred_id)))
cat(sprintf("  Unique entry_ids: %d\n", n_distinct(fred_with_ids$entry_id)))
```

## Step 7: Data Augmentation

```{r augmentation}
cat("\n### Step 7: Data Augmentation\n")

fred_augmented <- fred_with_ids

# Author overlap
if ("doi_o" %in% names(fred_augmented) && "doi_r" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with author overlap...\n")
  fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
    augment_with_author_overlap(fred_augmented)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Author overlap augmentation failed: ", e$message)
    fred_augmented
  })
}

# Clean references (APA + BibTeX) and individual fields with CrossRef + DataCite fallback
if (any(c("doi_o", "doi_r") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with clean references (APA + BibTeX) and individual fields...\n")
  fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
    # Get unique DOIs
    unique_dois <- unique(c(fred_augmented$doi_o, fred_augmented$doi_r))
    unique_dois <- unique_dois[!is.na(unique_dois)]

    # Fetch both APA and BibTeX references with individual fields (include_fields = TRUE by default)
    refs <- get_references(unique_dois)

    # Join references and individual fields to data
    fred_augmented %>%
      left_join(
        refs %>% rename(
          doi_o = doi,
          ref_o_clean = reference_apa,
          bibtex_o = reference_bibtex,
          title_o = title,
          author_o = author,
          journal_o = journal,
          year_o = year,
          volume_o = volume,
          issue_o = issue,
          pages_o = pages
        ),
        by = "doi_o"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        refs %>% rename(
          doi_r = doi,
          ref_r_clean = reference_apa,
          bibtex_r = reference_bibtex,
          title_r = title,
          author_r = author,
          journal_r = journal,
          year_r = year,
          volume_r = volume,
          issue_r = issue,
          pages_r = pages
        ),
        by = "doi_r"
      )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Reference augmentation failed: ", e$message)
    fred_augmented
  })
}

# Keywords (optional)
if ("doi_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with keywords...\n")
  fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
    augment_with_keywords(fred_augmented)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Keyword augmentation failed: ", e$message)
    fred_augmented
  })
}

# Language metadata from OpenAlex
if (any(c("doi_o", "doi_r") %in% names(fred_augmented))) {
  cat("\nAugmenting with language metadata from OpenAlex...\n")

  openalex_mailto <- Sys.getenv("OPENALEX_MAILTO", NA_character_)

  # Initialize language columns if not present
  if (!"language_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
    fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>% mutate(language_o = NA_character_)
  }
  if (!"language_r" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
    fred_augmented <- fred_augmented %>% mutate(language_r = NA_character_)
  }

  # Fetch for DOIs where language is missing
  dois_to_fetch_o <- fred_augmented %>%
    filter(!is.na(doi_o), is.na(language_o)) %>%
    pull(doi_o) %>% unique()

  dois_to_fetch_r <- fred_augmented %>%
    filter(!is.na(doi_r), is.na(language_r)) %>%
    pull(doi_r) %>% unique()

  cat(sprintf("  Fetching language for %d unique original DOIs and %d unique replication DOIs...\n",
              length(dois_to_fetch_o), length(dois_to_fetch_r)))

  # Fetch and join language for original DOIs
  if (length(dois_to_fetch_o) > 0) {
    fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
      meta_o <- get_openalex_language(dois_to_fetch_o, mailto = openalex_mailto)
      meta_o <- meta_o[!is.na(meta_o$doi), ]

      fred_augmented %>%
        left_join(meta_o %>% rename(doi_o = doi, language_o_new = language), by = "doi_o") %>%
        mutate(language_o = coalesce(language_o, language_o_new)) %>%
        select(-language_o_new)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Original DOI language lookup failed: ", e$message)
      fred_augmented
    })
  }

  # Fetch and join language for replication DOIs
  if (length(dois_to_fetch_r) > 0) {
    fred_augmented <- tryCatch({
      meta_r <- get_openalex_language(dois_to_fetch_r, mailto = openalex_mailto)
      meta_r <- meta_r[!is.na(meta_r$doi), ]

      fred_augmented %>%
        left_join(meta_r %>% rename(doi_r = doi, language_r_new = language), by = "doi_r") %>%
        mutate(language_r = coalesce(language_r, language_r_new)) %>%
        select(-language_r_new)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Replication DOI language lookup failed: ", e$message)
      fred_augmented
    })
  }

  cat(sprintf("  Original papers with language: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$language_o))))
  cat(sprintf("  Replication papers with language: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$language_r))))
}

cat("✓ Augmentation complete\n")
```

## Step 8: Save Output

```{r save}
cat("\n### Step 8: Saving output\n")

# Create output directory if needed
if (!dir.exists("output")) {
  dir.create("output")
}

# Save as Excel with formatting
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  fred_augmented,
  FRED_OUTPUT,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  asTable = TRUE
)

cat(sprintf("✓ Saved to: %s\n", FRED_OUTPUT))
cat(sprintf("  Rows: %d\n", nrow(fred_augmented)))
cat(sprintf("  Columns: %d\n", ncol(fred_augmented)))

# Summary statistics
cat("\n### Summary Statistics\n")
cat(sprintf("Effect-level entries: %d\n", nrow(fred_augmented)))
cat(sprintf("Unique original studies: %d\n",
            n_distinct(fred_augmented$doi_o, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Unique replications: %d\n",
            n_distinct(fred_augmented$doi_r, na.rm = TRUE)))

if ("author_overlap" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat(sprintf("Papers with author overlap data: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$author_overlap))))
}

if ("ref_o_clean" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with clean APA references: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$ref_o_clean))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with clean APA references: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$ref_r_clean))))
}

if ("bibtex_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with BibTeX: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$bibtex_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with BibTeX: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$bibtex_r))))
}

if ("title_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with title: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$title_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with title: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$title_r))))
}

if ("language_o" %in% names(fred_augmented)) {
  cat(sprintf("Original papers with language metadata: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$language_o))))
  cat(sprintf("Replication papers with language metadata: %d\n",
              sum(!is.na(fred_augmented$language_r))))
}
```
